goal: Decide if kappa-registry lets someone change a namespace. Only its owner, a key holder or a short chain of trust can write.

app.name: namespace-authorization
limits: It does not resolve namespaces or walk edges; it decides from the authority the walk found.
The redb store and the identity system are outside it.
app.title: Namespace authorization
app.purpose: Decide, as an XACML policy decision, whether an operation on a namespace is permitted, from the operation class, whether the store answered, what the target namespace is, the authority the asserter holds and the delegation hops it takes.

fields.name: store
fields.means: whether the store answered the delegation walk

fields.name: target
fields.means: the namespace: claimed, existing with no capability edges, absent, absent and reserved, or none

fields.name: grant
fields.means: the first authority the asserter holds, in authorize's order

fields.name: hops
fields.means: delegation hops walked to a capability holder

meanings.deny: Forbidden: access denied, or a reserved namespace needs _root authority
meanings.not-applicable: NotFound: a read of a namespace that does not exist
meanings.indeterminate: a store error during the auth check, so no decision is made

rules.why: crates/kappa-server/src/auth.rs authorize: an Exempt operation is Allowed before any check
auth.rs: a store error in the delegation walk is AuthError::Store, not a decision
auth.rs step 1: a capability on _root allows any namespace
auth.rs: an absent reserved namespace requires _root authority
auth.rs: reading an absent namespace is AuthError::NotFound
auth.rs: a write to an absent non-reserved namespace is AllowCreateNew, first writer claims
auth.rs step 3: a non-reserved namespace with no capability edges is open
auth.rs steps 2, 4, 5 and 6: owner, direct capability, parent namespace or held role
auth.rs check_delegation_inner: a delegation chain counts up to hop 5, AllowedViaDelegation

app.otherwiseWhy: auth.rs: no authority found, Forbidden access denied

properties.why: a claimed namespace is never read without authority
the delegation walk is bounded at five hops
a store error never becomes a permit or a deny

stakeholders.name: Namespace owner
stakeholders.text: Owns a namespace and needs nothing but an owner, a capability holder or a bounded delegation to write to it.

stakeholders.name: Registry operator
stakeholders.text: Runs the single-binary server for Docker, Git, S3, Nix and AT Protocol clients and needs reserved namespaces kept for _root.

concerns.name: Reserved namespaces protected
concerns.text: The reserved namespaces, such as kappa/protocols, kappa/runtimes and kappa/os, are created only with _root authority.

components.name: Protocol clients
components.text: docker push, git push, aws s3, nix copy and XRPC clients, each speaking its native protocol to the one server.

components.name: redb store
components.text: state.redb: tags, edges, sequences, namespaces and epochs, which the auth checks query.

threats.name: Delegation asserted by a third party
threats.text: Someone other than the source writes a delegation edge on its behalf to grant themselves access.

control.name: Source must assert
control.text: A delegation counts only if its asserter is its source.

threats.name: Unbounded delegation walk
threats.text: A long or cyclic delegation chain makes authorization walk without end or grants access far down a chain.

control.name: Five hops
control.text: The walk stops after hop 5, and beyond it nothing is permitted, proved for every request.

threats.name: Fail-open on an edge query error
threats.text: Step 3's edge query for an unclaimed namespace answers Allowed when the store errors.
threats.accepted: The app models a store error as indeterminate; auth.rs step 3 allows on an edge-query error, a fail-open recorded here for the repository to review.

quality.text: No read, write or admin of a claimed namespace is permitted without an owner, capability, role or delegation within five hops.
quality.measureText: Requests with no grant on a claimed namespace answered permit.
